## Optional timed setpoints per device

**Timed setpoints (30 s)** is off by default, including after upgrading from Beta 109. Enable it separately on the devices that need it. On the HEM card, expand the room and device and look below **Control · Method**. The switch is also available under **Configuration** on the managed device in Home Assistant.

| Setting | On/off heating or cooling starts | On/off heating or cooling stops |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Off** (default) | HEM can send the active setpoint as soon as the native mode confirms ON and existing protections permit it: maximum for heating, minimum for cooling. | HEM sends the normal eligible OFF command directly. No opposite setpoint or added wait. |
| **On** | Wait 30 seconds after native ON before sending the active setpoint. | Send the native minimum for heating or maximum for cooling, then wait 30 seconds before OFF. |

The option also controls the startup grace for native setpoint-only, manual/profile, temperature-range and humidity commands. The before-OFF temperature change applies only to thermostatic on/off heating and cooling. Temperature limits come from the native device. Existing startup readiness, dwell, device availability and other protections still apply.

Changing this preference does not change the control method or grant power permission. If a shutdown setpoint has already been dispatched, HEM finishes that cycle safely even if the option is switched off or the integration is upgraded. Future cycles use the current preference.

Update in HACS, restart Home Assistant, then refresh the dashboard.
